frame: hand frame: wrist joint at the origin, -Z toward the fingertips, +Y back of the hand, thumb +X (left) / -X (right)
note_layout: in the file the two hand roots sit 0.12 m either side of the root for viewing; the runtime places each hand root itself

animations.naming: each pose exists three times: <pose> (both hands), <pose>.L and <pose>.R (one hand only), so the hands can be crossfaded independently
animations.keys: one key at t=0 (bone rotations only), except syringe_hold: t=0 hold, t=1 s thumb pressed about 2 cm (syringe_push is the pressed pose alone)

grip_rule: place the held item so that its anchor empty coincides with the hand grip empty: item_root_world = grip_world * inverse(anchor_in_item)

grip_anchor_in_item.grip_syringe: syringe_*: the `flange` empty (origin on the barrel axis at the finger flange, +Z toward the tip)
grip_anchor_in_item.grip_mask: face_mask_adult: the root / `seat` empty (+Z away from the face, +Y toward the nasal bridge)
grip_anchor_in_item.grip_bag: reservoir_bag_3l: the `squeeze_center` empty (+Z toward the thumb side, +Y along the bag toward the neck)
grip_anchor_in_item.grip_laryngoscope: laryngoscope_mac: the `grip` empty (+Y up the handle toward the end cap, +Z toward the open blade)
grip_anchor_in_item.grip_pinch: a flow-control knob: its front face center, +Z out of the knob toward the hand (controls.json gives knob axes)

grip_parent: grip empties are children of the hand armature node (hand frame); no pose moves the wrist bone

materials.nitrile_blue_L / _R: blue nitrile: roughness 0.34, sheen, wrinkle normal map glove_normal_L / _R
materials.skin_forearm: bare forearm between the glove cuff and the cut
